raw_states.limitation: Frozen teacher/embedding weights are intentionally absent from trainable checkpoints and remain bound to prepared assets. Micro-steps are reconstructed from their dedicated raw rank-state field and checked against observed traces; DeepSpeed model files do not serialize that field.

runtime.cpu_coordinator_scheduling: All three CPU observer/coordinator jobs are low-priority/normal; actual GPU work remains a separately accounted high-priority/spec-priority step inside the protected full-node allocation.
limitations: CPU pre/post observations establish the shared environment envelope, not GPU-node system executable/driver binary identity or absence of an adversarial transient change.
Actual GPU backend flags and hardware bindings remain the source-bound worker/scan observations.
A newly created compiled extension is reported as new and is not described as preexisting unchanged.

schedules.scope: independent masks, eligibility Boolean intersections, paired schedules and committed exposure only; not independent GPU argmax recomputation or tokenizer replay

state_comparisons.limitation: Compares actual retained source-bound state identities and scalar traces. Does not independently unpickle/recompute full raw ZeRO model/Adam/scaler states; checkpoint inventory and loader assertions remain separate evidence.

stock.scope: Exact exported trainable/vocabulary identity and genuine stock continuation on one synthetic prompt per rank. Does not require greedy token equality or assert quality, speedup, universal losslessness or a matched stopping benchmark.

suffix.bounds: At fixed production shape, retained real-prefix teacher/head logits and scaled logit gradients require tensor equality, treating signed zero as equal; normalized head and total CE absolute difference<=5e-5. Full owned pre-step partition/state/update traces require exact equality. A numerical mismatch is not waived by the former decoder policy.
